'''Forrest Wesley Young''' (April 10, 1940 – 2006) was a professor emeritus of [[quantitative psychology]] at the [[University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill|University of North Carolina]] and President of the [[Psychometric Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Past, Present and Incoming Presidents|url=https://www.psychometricsociety.org/content/past-present-and-incoming-presidents|website=psychometricsociety.org|publisher=Psychometric Society|accessdate=7 March 2017}}</ref> He is the developer of [[ViSta, The Visual Statistics system|ViSta]] a software for data visualization.<ref>{{cite journal|title=The History of ViSta: The Visual Statistics System|first1=Pedro |last1=Valero-Mora|first2=Rubén D.|last2=Ledesma |first3=Michael |last3=Friendly|date=1 May 2012 |journal=WIREs Comput Stat|volume=4|issue=3|pages=295–306|doi=10.1002/wics.1203|hdl=11336/273318|hdl-access=free}}</ref>

==Books==

*Schiffman, S.S., Reynolds, M.L. & Young, F.W. (1981). ''Introduction to Multidimensional Scaling''. New York: Academic Press.
*Young, F.W. & Sarle, W.S. (1982). ''Exploratory Multivariate Data Analysis''. Cary, NC: SAS Institute, Inc.
*Young, F.W. & Hamer, R.M. (1987). ''Multidimensional Scaling: History, Theory and Applications''. New York: Erlbaum Associates. (reprinted, 1994)
